name: @bybrawe/opencode-loop
reason: User-authorized installer contract patch from main. Publish Loop 0.6.6 with Loop-only installation as the default: do not install, detect, refresh, migrate, or modify the dedicated OpenCode Goal package unless --with-goals is explicitly requested; omit legacy /loop-goal* commands unless --with-loop-goals is explicitly requested; recommend the independently installable Goal 1.3.47 companion and preserve cross-plugin coexistence gates. Final release workflow is aligned to v0.6.6 tags/artifacts and the 0.6.6 release notes. Goal 1.3.47 is pinned to its retriggered current-main release candidate.
